caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur rendered in a realistic style, with predominantly golden brown and bronze tones. The main structure features a U-shaped body, curved and sturdy, with circular, knob-like accents at the ends where a pair of reddish-brown leather straps—rendered with light highlights and shadows—emerge and flow downwards out of the frame. A horizontal arm extends outwards from the main body, ending in a large, circular, gear-like rowel with evenly spaced, pointed teeth colored in a muted steel grey. The background is a pale off-white, and the composition places the object centrally with soft gradation and minimal shadow, creating a clear focus on the spur while maintaining an uncluttered appearance.
title: Spur
